test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

A real warrior does not ________ (surrender) to his enemies.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'yield.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Surrender'** means to stop resisting to an enemy or opponent and submit to their authority. (दुश्मन या प्रतिद्वंद्वी के सामने प्रतिरोध करना बंद करना और उनके अधिकार को मान्यता देना।)

 
 
• **Example Sentence:** The dictator refused to surrender to the rebelling forces.
 
 
 
• **'Yield'** in this context also means to surrender or give up, especially in a context of war or conflict. (समर्पण करना या हार मान लेना)
 
 
• **Example Sentence:** The king had to yield his throne when the revolutionaries stormed the palace.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Expose: **Reveal or lay open to danger. (प्रकट करना )
 
• **Smile: **Form one's features into a pleased, kind, or amused expression. (अपनी सुविधाओं को प्रसन्न, दयालु, या मनोरंजक अभिव्यक्ति में ढालें।)
 
• **Cooperate:** Work jointly towards the same end. (समान अंत की ओर संयुक्त रूप से काम करना।)
